items.title: Milton Batiste Interview, 1997-02-05
items.q: Albert Walters is a trumpet player.

ctx.x: So I think that was the. That's the question mark. I think. Is Albert Walters on there?
Albert Walters is a trumpet player.
Okay. So Albert Walters is playing trumpet.

items.title: Milton Batiste Interview, 1997-02-05
items.q: John Walters, that was Piggy's son. I mean, Piggy, his name was Piggy. John Walters Sr. was his father.

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah. John Walters, that was Piggy's son. I mean, Piggy, his name was Piggy. John Walters Sr. was his father. So that's one, two, that played professionally I would say. They got a lot of them that went into professional businesses and professional things and teaching and so forth, but they never played anymore. Like Wesley McJulian was in our class. He was an alto player. He's Dr. Wesley McJulian. He wasn't very much seventh grade now. I'm not even mentioning the other people because they died. Some of…
Just going back through my list here, how did you get the nickname Half Ahead?
